scores.evidence: Critical path: Stripe Connect platform approval → S3 → payments adapter (T14) → M1 end-to-end scenario → M2 shadow billing → M3 live cycle.
scores.rationale: Platform/tenancy/money primitives precede domain slices, with explicit dependency notes per task and spikes proving risks before dependent tasks.

scores.evidence: M1 – Walking skeleton + spikes: ... deployed to staging through CI... generates a numbered invoice, charges a Stripe test card... sends a signed webhook
scores.rationale: M1 is a real end-to-end slice deployed via CI/CD with deploy and rollback, before breadth features, though to staging rather than prod.

scores.evidence: D4 ... Revisit if: Sustained ingest above roughly 3k/s, about 50M events/day... ; D1 Reversibility: Hard
scores.rationale: Irreversible decisions D1–D12 list options, defaults, reversibility and flip conditions, plus labelled assumptions with validation.

scores.evidence: T5 base migrations, RLS template → T6 tenancy context → T8 isolation suite before domain slices; spikes S1–S4 first
scores.rationale: Widest-impact work (tenancy, RLS, money, infra, risk spikes) precedes leaf modules within M1, with explicit ordering.

scores.evidence: T6 tenancy context... T16 ...delivery to http://169.254.169.254 is blocked; Security (built from M1; external pen test in M3)
scores.rationale: Security has concrete treatment in M1 (RLS, hashed keys, SSRF, isolation suite), M2 (SSO/roles), M3 (pen test), M4 (SOC 2 evidence).

scores.evidence: Observability (basic in M1, full in M3) ... T4 – Wire OpenTelemetry... Add 2 alerts
scores.rationale: Present from M1 with concrete alerts, but M2 and M4 observability is thin and much is deferred to M3 and a standalone section.

scores.evidence: T2 ... Done when terraform plan shows no changes after apply in staging; CI uses Testcontainers; synthetic generators only
scores.rationale: Reproducible infra, migrations, builds and tests appear in M1, but reproducibility is not explicitly carried through each later phase.

scores.evidence: Flow 2 failure paths; T17 (a) killing the worker mid-finalise and retrying produces one invoice; M2 dunning, webhook retries; M3 restore drill
scores.rationale: Failure handling (idempotency, retries, circuit breaker, dunning, restore drills) is built in M1 and extended in each later milestone.

scores.evidence: AI-specific concerns. Not applicable. There are no AI components in scope.
scores.rationale: Plan explicitly declares the AI layer N/A and adds no AI components.

scores.evidence: Deferred Work: Non-Stripe payment adapters | More than 30% of qualified pipeline needs them (D1)
scores.rationale: Explicit deferred table with triggers, plus non-goals, per-milestone out-of-scope lists and deliberate shortcuts.

note: Strong, thorough billing plan with a real walking skeleton, explicit decision gates and deferred-work triggers; weaker only on observability and reproducibility being threaded through every later phase.
